how_funnel:
Counts applicants who applied within the date range at the top of the page.
The steps are this company's statuses marked "Hiring step" in General Settings → Statuses, in the order they're listed there.
An applicant has reached a step if their current status, or any status they had before, is that step or a later one. Skipping a step still counts as passing it.
Everyone counts at the first step when it's the status new applicants start in (e.g. Pending).
The % next to each step = applicants who reached it ÷ applicants who reached the step before.
"Left here" counts applicants whose current status is a "Way out" (e.g. Rejected), shown under the furthest step they reached.
The Job menu limits everything to one job.
how_ratios:
Selection ratio = applicants who reached "{status}" (the last hiring step) ÷ all applicants who applied in the last {days} days.
The table and the other three numbers cover jobs posted in the last {days} days (posting = the application start date, or the creation date).
Time to fill: for each job, days from posting to the first time any applicant reached "{status}" (from the status history dates). The tile shows the middle value (median) across filled jobs.
Time to hire: for the same first person in each job, days from their application to the day they reached "{status}". Applications dated before the job was posted count from the posting date. Median across filled jobs.
Fill rate = filled positions ÷ open positions, where each job counts at most as many hires as its openings. A job counts as filled by anyone who ever reached "{status}".
how_trend:
New applications per day within the date range, by the day they applied (in your time zone).
The change compares this period with the period of the same length just before it.
how_sources:
Applicants who applied within the date range (trashed ones left out), grouped by where they applied from.
The source comes from the application link (its ?source= / UTM tag) or the site that sent them. "Not tracked" means no source was recorded, which includes everyone from before source tracking started.
% = that source's applicants ÷ all applicants in the range.
how_jobs:
Lists active jobs only, and is NOT limited by the date range: the counts cover all time.
Total = all applicants to the job except trashed ones. New this week = those who applied in the last 7 days.
Interviewed = applicants with at least one interview booked in the app.
Offered = applicants who were sent an offer from the app (sent or accepted).
Hired = applicants with a signed contract in the app, or whose status is "hired", whichever is higher.
Last application turns amber when nobody has applied for 14 days. The list is sorted by new applicants this week, then total.
how_speed:
Covers applicants who applied within the date range.
To interview: days from applying to their first interview booked in the app (cancelled ones ignored).
To offer: days from applying to the first offer sent from the app.
To contract: days from applying to the first contract signed in the app.
Each number is the median (middle value), so a few very slow or fast cases don't skew it. "Median of N" is how many applicants it's based on.
The table shows the 8 jobs with the most applicants.
how_rejection:
Counts the reasons chosen each time an applicant was moved to "rejected". Rejections without a reason are left out.
If an applicant was rejected with several reasons, each reason counts once. If they were rejected twice, both times count.
This card covers ALL time: it does not follow the date range at the top of the page.
Shares are each reason's part of the reasons shown.
how_m_applicants: Counts applicants who applied in the last {days} days.
how_m_interviews: Counts interviews booked in the app (cancelled ones left out) whose interview date is in the last {days} days.
how_m_reachedStatus: Counts applicants who applied in the last {days} days and reached "{status}".
how_m_conversion: % = applicants who reached "{status}" ÷ all applicants in that group (applied in the last {days} days).
how_m_avgDaysToStatus: Average days from applying to first reaching "{status}", for applicants (applied in the last {days} days) who got there.
how_m_avgMatchScore: Average AI match score (0–100) of applicants who applied in the last {days} days and have a score.
how_m_avgExpectedSalary: Average of the expected salary applicants entered (applied in the last {days} days). Blank, zero or values above 1,000,000 are left out.
how_m_medianExpectedSalary: Middle value (median) of the expected salary applicants entered (applied in the last {days} days). Blank, zero or values above 1,000,000 are left out.
how_reachRule: If "{status}" is a hiring step, reaching any later step also counts, using the order in General Settings → Statuses. Otherwise the applicant must have had "{status}" at some point.
how_g_job: Grouped by the job they applied to.
how_g_source: Grouped by where they applied from (the tracked link source). "Not tracked" means unknown.
how_g_gender: Grouped by gender. "Unknown" means it wasn't given.
how_g_department: Grouped by the department of the job they applied to.
how_g_rejectionReason: Grouped by the reasons chosen the last time they were rejected. An applicant with several reasons counts once in each.
how_g_ageBand: Grouped by age, worked out from their birth date. Ages under 15 or over 80 (usually placeholder dates) count as "Unknown".
how_g_weekday: Grouped by the day of the week they applied.
how_g_time: Grouped by the {unit} they applied (for interviews: the interview date). Periods with nothing show as 0.
how_g_field: Grouped by their answer to the form question "{label}". Only applicants to jobs whose form asks it are counted, and an applicant who picked several answers counts once in each.
how_split_status: Each colour is a current status.
how_split_rejectionReason: Each colour is a rejection reason.
how_split_ageBand: Each colour is an age group.
how_split_weekday: Each colour is a day of the week.
how_split_field: Each colour is an answer to "{label}".
how_cumulative: Running total: each period adds up everything before it.
how_stacked100: Each bar is stretched to 100%, so it shows each colour's share within that bar.
how_percentLabels: Percentages are each part's share of the whole chart.
how_others: Shows the top {n} groups; all the rest are added together as "Other".
how_maxSeries: At most the 8 largest colours (series) are shown.
how_avgEmpty: Groups with nothing to average are left out.
how_totalRow: The total row adds up each column.
how_overallRow: The bottom row is the overall value for everyone in the chart, not a sum of the rows.
